questions.stem: Before siting a lumbar epidural in labour, what should be stopped first?
questions.answer: Oxytocin augmentation

questions.stem: In pregnancy, at which lumbar level does Tuffier's line usually cross?
Which lumbar level does Tuffier's (intercristal) line usually mark for epidural siting?
Which lumbar interspaces are marked for a lumbar epidural?
How does the choice of interspace for an epidural differ from a spinal?
questions.answer: An epidural can be sited at any interspace

questions.stem: In a lumbar epidural, which patient factors make the spinous processes hard to feel?
questions.answer: Obesity, previous back surgery

questions.stem: In an epidural, which position is more comfortable for the patient?
Why is sitting less suitable for a labouring woman having an epidural?
questions.answer: Makes external fetal monitoring difficult

questions.stem: Which syringe is used to detect loss of resistance during epidural needle advance?
questions.answer: Low-resistance syringe

questions.stem: What is the usual depth from skin to ligamentum flavum in a normal-sized adult epidural?
How do you estimate epidural depth when the needle markings are not numbered?
questions.answer: Count the marks visible between skin and hub, then subtract from the needle length

questions.stem: A 9cm epidural needle shows 4 marks between skin and hub. What depth does this give?
Why might a midline epidural miss the supraspinous ligament?
questions.answer: A floppy needle or lateral angle takes it off midline

questions.stem: During a midline epidural, bone met less than 2 cm deep most likely means what?
Warm clear fluid coming from an epidural needle hub most suggests what?
How far past the needle tip should an epidural catheter be threaded?
What is the risk of threading an epidural catheter less than 3 cm into the space?
questions.answer: It may migrate out of the space

questions.stem: In a midline epidural using a glass syringe, how much saline is used for loss of resistance?
How should the epidural needle be advanced in the midline approach?
questions.answer: Mm by mm, styletted, bevel cephalad

questions.stem: What does a sudden loss of resistance on entering the epidural space resemble?
questions.answer: A good IV cannula

questions.stem: What does bony resistance felt throughout the midline passage suggest?
questions.answer: Ossified ligaments or an arthritic spine

questions.stem: What happens to a drop of saline on the needle hub when the negative-pressure epidural space is entered?
questions.answer: It is sucked into the needle

questions.stem: In the hanging drop technique, what does the saline drop on the hub do while the needle passes through the ligaments?
questions.answer: It stays put

questions.stem: How is the epidural space located during the midline approach?
questions.answer: By loss of resistance or hanging drop

questions.stem: What are the risks of threading an epidural catheter more than 7 cm into the space?
questions.answer: More unilateral block, venous puncture and knotting

questions.stem: Once an epidural catheter is past the Tuohy tip, pulling it back through the needle risks ____.
questions.answer: shearing

questions.stem: What can prevent an epidural catheter from being advanced?
questions.answer: Narrow space, needle near dura, blocked orifice, or false loss of resistance

questions.stem: What should aspirating an epidural catheter show?
questions.answer: No blood or CSF

questions.stem: Which drug is considered for an epidural test dose, with or without adrenaline 1:200,000?
questions.answer: Lidocaine

questions.stem: What is the aim of an epidural test dose?
questions.answer: Detect intrathecal or intravascular placement

questions.stem: Why do some argue that aspiration checks are unnecessary before a labour epidural?
questions.answer: Labour solutions are very dilute, so aspiration is usually diagnostic

questions.stem: Why is aspiration not always reliable for checking epidural catheter position?
questions.answer: Not always predictive, especially with single-orifice catheters

questions.stem: What is a typical lidocaine test dose for an epidural?
questions.answer: 40-60mg lidocaine (2-3ml 2%)

questions.stem: Which bupivacaine dose range is used for epidural test dosing in practice?
What adrenaline concentration is used as an intravascular marker in an epidural test dose?
How sensitive is aspirating a multi-orifice epidural catheter for intravascular placement?
Why should every epidural dose, initial or top-up, be treated as a test dose?
questions.answer: Catheters can migrate intrathecally or intravascularly later

questions.stem: What does blood in an epidural catheter most likely indicate?
questions.answer: Epidural vein cannulation

questions.stem: What does pain or paraesthesia on threading an epidural catheter suggest?
questions.answer: The catheter is near a nerve root

questions.stem: For a short surgical epidural case, how far should the catheter be withdrawn in the space?
What advantage does the paramedian approach give over a midline approach?
questions.answer: A larger opening into the epidural space

questions.stem: When is a paramedian epidural approach preferred over a midline approach?
questions.answer: Patient cannot be positioned or flexed, calcified ligaments, or spinal deformity

questions.stem: For a paramedian epidural, where is the skin wheal placed relative to the upper spinous process?
questions.answer: About 1 cm lateral and 1 cm caudal to its lower edge

questions.stem: In a paramedian epidural, at what angle is the needle set off the sagittal plane?
